observed_host_boundary.detail: Original UpgradeManager.lua640 blocked at EquipWeapon after SetupHeroObject/AttachLua/AddToGroup. Does not establish combat execution.

native_action.selectors: ScriptArgs DestinationIDs + DestinationNames resolved through World::GetActiveMapThings; loops every requested Names entry and selected active Thing.
steps: LoadPackages bool defaultfalse: when true requests asynchronous asset package named after each weapon. First original call omitsit.
Native selected Thing must pass flags check ((~thingFieldAt8)&0x221)==0. Unit.mArsenal at0x428 is then used. Semantic decoding of full type flags is outside this pass.
Weapon::Create(name,arsenal.pOwner) looks up GameDataManager::GetWeaponData and allocates appropriate subclass pool; absent data returnsnull.
Arsenal::AddWeapon(newWeapon,false) performs actual controls/arsenal/bundled dependency state changes.
If weaponData.mDef.ReloadOnEquip true (WeaponData+0x8bc), reload then cooldown(-1).
native_action.ignored_not_fabricated: Action does not expose a success return. A reconstruction should report missing data/state rather than treat unknown weapon creation as successful.

delegated_routines.Weapon::Create_data: 0x850f0,1301bytes; actual GunWeapon pool selected forGUN, vtable assignment at0x1800854da

required_state.owner: Existing selected live unit and distinct WeaponArsenal {pOwner,mWeapons,mControllableWeapons}; no global fake weapon list.
required_state.per_instance: Weapon owns a copy of WeaponData/definition, mOwnerId and cached ownername, four resolved controls, projectile/spawned projectile data and validity flags, mAmmo, mClipShotsRemaining, mChargeTimeRemaining, mCooldownTimeRemaining, mReloadTimeRemaining, clip regen time, charging state.
required_state.controls: SetupControls resolves Control/AlternateControl/SecondaryControl/DisallowedControl strings from original global RemappableControl table. Null control pointers are possible; default controllable classification requires pControl nonnull, DefaultControl true, ControlWindow<=0 and nonbundledAdd.
required_state.arsenal_add: Sets up controls, appends weapon to mWeapons, recursively creates missing bundled named weapons. Adds to mControllableWeapons only under recovered control/default/window conditions. It also iterates native effect entries of type8 to add referenced weapons; full effect-type semantics not decoded here.
required_state.initialization: Weapon::init copies data/def, sets controls/owner identity, looks up and copies original projectile data, initializes charge/clip/ammo fields from definitions, handles ReloadOnCreation and InitialCooldown. Exact omitted compiled WeaponData defaults are still required.
required_state.reload_cooldown: reload picks ReloadTime or native RNG range[min,max], writes mReloadTimeRemaining, immediately onReloadFinished when<=0. cooldown picks configured cooldown or native RNG range then positive explicit argument override, max with existing remaining. -1 uses configured cooldown, not forcedzero.
